about: Twilight's Eve Callings for the first slice (Basic Warrior, Tier 1 Warrior, Champion's locked quest). Every spell, talent and tab id is a real 1.12.1 record, checked by tools/twilights-eve/extract_spells.py verify. Design notes: docs/reference/skills-and-talents.md.

formula_conventions.L: the character's level inside its current Tier (1..Tier Cap); it resets to 1 on Advancement
formula_conventions.AP: melee attack power at cast time (Battle Shout and other buffs included)
formula_conventions.W: a normal white-swing damage roll: rand(weapon min..max) + AP / 14 * weapon speed (unarmed: 1..2 dmg at speed 2.0)
formula_conventions.Wn: a normalized roll: rand(weapon min..max) + AP / 14 * normalized speed (2.4 one-hand, 3.3 two-hand, 1.7 dagger), as vanilla Overpower and Mortal Strike
formula_conventions.linear: {base, per_level, per_ap} means round(base + per_level * L + per_ap * AP), rounding half away from zero, never below `min` (default 0)
formula_conventions.rage: rage values are whole rage points; Spell.dbc stores rage costs in tenths (150 = 15 rage)
formula_conventions.realm_vs_client: `client` is what Spell.dbc makes the stock client show and enforce before it sends a cast (cost, range, stance, aura states, on-next-swing); it is checked by the extractor. `realm` is what the Local Realm does; it must keep realm cost >= client cost or the client refuses casts the realm would allow.

tier_bonus.about: Flat additions to base stats (UNIT_FIELD_STAT0..4 base values), cumulative per Tier, applied on top of the race/class base table at the character's current level. +12 Stamina is about +120 health, so a level 1 Tier 1 Warrior (~180 hp) sits near a level 7 Basic Warrior; +12 Strength is +24 attack power.

respec_cost_copper.about: vanilla's escalating wipe cost, reset on Advancement

basic_warrior.client_shapeshift_form_note: Battle Stance. The stock client refuses a cast whose Spell.dbc Stances mask excludes the current form (0x612480), before sending it. Charge, Rend, Thunder Clap, Hamstring and Overpower all need Battle Stance, so the realm keeps UNIT_FIELD_BYTES_1 byte 2 = 17 for every Warrior Calling. It also makes GetBonusBarOffset() 1, so the main action bar pages to slots 73..84.

skills.name: Heroic Strike
skills.vanilla_reference: R1 L1 +11, R2 L8 +21, R3 L16 +32, R4 L24 +44: bonus = 9.5 + 1.4 L fits within 1 point to L24.
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says +11 (rank 1) at every level; the realm adds more from L2.

skills.name: Charge
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says 9 rage; realm gives 9 at L1-10.

skills.name: Rend
skills.vanilla_reference: R1 L4 5/tick x3, R2 L10 7/tick x4, R4 L30 11/tick x6. Kept at 3 ticks (the tooltip's 9 s) and grown per tick.

skills.name: Thunder Clap
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says 10 damage, 10% slower attacks for 10 sec, up to 4 targets.

skills.name: Battle Shout
skills.vanilla_reference: R1 is 15 AP + 0.5/level to its MaxLevel 11 (RealPointsPerLevel). The formula is exactly the client's own $s1, so the tooltip is right at every Tier 0 level.
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip scales with level itself (15 at L1, 19.5 at L10); realm rounds half up, so it may differ by 1.

skills.name: Overpower

realm.requires: the target dodged the caster in the last 5 s. AttributesEx 0x00100000 makes the stock client grey the button and refuse the cast while PLAYER_FIELD_BYTES combo points are 0, so on a dodge the realm sets 1 combo point on that target (vmangos does the same) and clears it on cast or after 5 s.

skills.vanilla_reference: R1 L12 +5, R2 L28 +15, R3 L44 +25. 2 + 0.5 L gives +3..+7 over Tier 0, near rank 1.

skills.name: Bloodrage
skills.vanilla_reference: 10 rage now, 10 over 10 s, 20% of base health (Spell.dbc ManaCostPercentage 20, power type health). The only ranks-free skill: rank text is already empty.
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says 10 rage then 10 over 10 sec; realm grows the instant part to 12 by L10 so every skill scales with level.

talent_tree.catalog_note: Replaces the client's TalentCatalog for this Calling: one tab, class_mask 1, race_mask 511. Talent ids and rank spells are real Talent.dbc rows re-seated on the new grid; ranks are a prefix of the real ones (Cruelty and Improved Battle Shout cut to 3). Tier n needs 5*(n-1) points in the tab, so 9 points reach tier 2 only.

warrior.client_shapeshift_form_note: Battle Stance again: every Tier 1 skill below is legal in it. Whirlwind, Intercept and Pummel (Berserker only) and Revenge and Shield Block (Defensive only) were left out for that reason.

skills.name: Mortal Strike
skills.vanilla_reference: R1 L40 +85 (talent, 31 points deep). Given as the Tier 1 signature strike: +22 at L1, +80 at L30.

realm.requires: as Basic Warrior's Overpower (combo point on dodge)

skills.name: Execute

realm.requires: target at or below 20% health. TargetAuraState 2 makes the stock client grey the button unless the target's UNIT_FIELD_AURASTATE has bit 0x2 (AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_20_PERCENT), so the realm sets and clears that bit on every unit as its health crosses 20%.

skills.vanilla_reference: R1 L24 125 + 3 per extra rage, R2 L32 200 + 6.
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says 125 damage, 3 per extra rage.

skills.name: Battle Shout
skills.tooltip_note: Tooltip says 55 until L22, then +0.5/level (its own scaling) up to 59 at L30; the realm gives 22 at L1 rising to 80 at L30.

talent_tree.catalog_note: Three tabs on the real Arms, Fury and Protection pages, cut at tier 5 (20 points in a tab), so 29 points reach Sweeping Strikes, Death Wish or Concussion Blow with 9 left. Talents tied to skills or stances this Calling lacks are dropped (Tactical Mastery, Anger Management, Improved Heroic Strike, Improved Demoralizing Shout, Improved Slam, Improved Intercept, Improved Bloodrage, Improved Shield Block, Improved Revenge, Defiance, Improved Sunder Armor, Improved Disarm, Improved Taunt, Improved Shield Wall, Improved Shield Bash). Seats are the real ones except One-Handed Weapon Specialization (tier 6 to tier 4) and Last Stand, which loses its Improved Bloodrage prerequisite.

advancement_quest.zone_or_sort_note: QuestSort.dbc 81 'Warrior': the stock quest log files it under a Warrior header.
advancement_quest.title: The Warrior's Path
advancement_quest.details: You have learned all a Basic Warrior can learn, $N. Strength alone carried you this far; from here, discipline must carry you further.$B$BTake up the warrior's path and you begin again, untested, among the youngest of our blades. But you will not be the same fighter you were. Your body remembers. Your arm is stronger.$B$BSay the word, and it begins.
advancement_quest.objectives: Speak with the Warrior trainer at the Crossroads to take up the warrior's path.
advancement_quest.offer_reward_text: Then it is done. Forget your old habits, $N: you are a Warrior now, and a Warrior starts over. Go and earn your scars again.

objective.note: No item or kill: accept and complete at the same NPC, like vanilla's 'Veteran Uzzek' (1505) speak-to quest.

advancement_quest.flavour_source: Vanilla Horde warrior quests 1505 'Veteran Uzzek' and 1498 'Path of Defense' (Uzzek, Far Watch Post, the Barrens, creature 5810) for tone only; no text is copied.

advancement_quest.title: The Champion's Trial
advancement_quest.details: Thirty battles' worth of scars, and still standing. Few warriors come this far, $N.$B$BThe Champions do not take just anyone. When they are ready to test you, I will send word. Until then, keep this charge with you, and keep your blade sharp.

objective.note: A single objective the realm never credits (or a kill of a creature entry that is never spawned), so the stock quest log shows it as in progress forever and the trainer shows the 'incomplete' text. Abandoning and retaking it is harmless.

advancement_quest.request_items_text: The Champions have not yet sent for you, $N. Patience.
advancement_quest.flavour_source: The vanilla level 30 warrior chain (1718 'The Islander', 1791 'The Windwatcher', 1712 'Cyclonian') for tone only.
